SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.25
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system ILIKE 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ti'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pt'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ga'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'W'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Nb'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Sc'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Pd'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.1)
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ca.element AS a_site,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.site_label,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.60
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

    0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))

    + 0.3 * (cp.value / 300.0)

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT DISTINCT

  CASE

    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN 'Q2: low formation energy / above hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'Q3: high formation energy / on hull'
    ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / above hull'
  END AS stability_quadrant

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_match_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.4 * ps.energy_above_hull
        + 0.3 * ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)
        - 0.3 * (cp.value / 100.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
       AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low hull distance'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'Q2: high formation energy / low hull distance'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05 THEN 'Q3: low formation energy / high hull distance'
    ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / high hull distance'
  END AS stability_quadrant

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC

  )

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.is_stable,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_c11.value AS "C11",
        cp_c12.value AS "C12",
        cp_c44.value AS "C44",
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
        END AS stability_score,
        1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_score,
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
             AND cp_c44.value > 0
             AND cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value > 0
            THEN (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
    WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
)
SELECT
    formula,
    is_stable,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_diff,
    "C11",
    "C12",
    "C44",
    stability_score,
    lattice_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff

SELECT m.formula,

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap

    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT

JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND EXISTS (

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC

SELECT

  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stab.value AS energy_above_hull,
  cp_mis.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS c11,
  cp_c12.value AS c12,
  cp_c44.value AS c44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_mis ON cp_mis.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_mis.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'L12'
WHERE cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stab.value <= 0.001
  AND ABS(cp_mis.value) <= 0.02
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY cp_stab.value ASC, ABS(cp_mis.value) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
ORDER BY
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stability.value AS stability,
  cp_mismatch.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (-cp_stability.value)
    + 0.3 * (-ABS(cp_mismatch.value))
    + 0.3 * cp_bm.value
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_mismatch ON cp_mismatch.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_mismatch.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (m.formula ~ 'Ni' OR m.formula ~ 'Co' OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%Ni%' OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%Co%')
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system AS element_combination,
  COUNT(*) AS material_count,
  AVG(cp.value) AS avg_stability_value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY avg_stability_value ASC, material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  cp.value / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS ranking_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ranking_score DESC, lattice_diff ASC, bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS "C11",
    cp_c12.value AS "C12",
    cp_c44.value AS "C44",
    ((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0) AS bulk_modulus,
    cp_stability.value AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_proto ON cp_proto.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_proto.property_name = 'prototype'
  AND cp_proto.tensor_component = 'L12'
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'is_stable'
ORDER BY cp_stability.value DESC,
         ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC,
         ((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0) DESC,
         cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    cp_a.value AS lattice_a,
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_l12.property_name = 'L12'
    AND cp_l12.value = 1
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
    AND cp_stable.value = 1
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co(-|$)'
ORDER BY ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low energy above hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN 'Q2: low formation energy / high energy above hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'Q3: high formation energy / low energy above hull'
    ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / high energy above hull'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_a.value AS lattice_a,
       ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'is_l12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
  AND NOT (m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Al(-|$)' AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)')
ORDER BY ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  CASE
    WHEN m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn)(-|$)' THEN '3d transition metal'
    WHEN m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)' THEN '4d/5d transition metal'
  END AS transition_metal_group
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY transition_metal_group, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula,
       cp_stab.value AS energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND m.reduced_formula ~ '^([A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?|[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3)$'
  AND cp_stab.value < (
      SELECT cp_ref_stab.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref_stab ON cp_ref_stab.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
      WHERE m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
         OR m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      ORDER BY cp_ref_stab.value ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp_bm.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref_bm.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref

  stability_score,
  lattice_matching_score,
  elastic_score,
  stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    cp.value AS C11,
    cp12.value AS C12,
    cp44.value AS C44,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
      WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS stability_score,
    CASE
      WHEN s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS lattice_matching_score,
    CASE
      WHEN cp.value > cp12.value
       AND cp.value + 2.0 * cp12.value > 0.0
       AND cp44.value > 0.0
      THEN 1.0
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS elastic_score
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
  JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
  JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
  JOIN calculated_property cp12 ON calc.calculation_id = cp12.calculation_id
  JOIN calculated_property cp44 ON calc.calculation_id = cp44.calculation_id
  WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    AND cp.tensor_component = 'C11'
    AND cp12.tensor_component = 'C12'
    AND cp44.tensor_component = 'C44'
) ranked_l12
ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_match_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
      * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
      * cp.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_per_atom,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
